section.title: Reviews
section.noAverage: The average rating shows from {min} reviews on.
section.empty: No reviews of this place yet
section.emptyHint: Only guests who booked through Bayit and stayed here can write a review.
section.showMore: {count, plural, one {1 more review} other {{count} more reviews}}
section.realOnly: Every review was written by a guest who booked and stayed here. A review can't be edited or deleted once it is posted.
section.unavailable: Reviews can't be shown right now. Try refreshing the page in a few minutes.
section.allReviews: {count, plural, one {See the review} other {See all {countText} reviews}}

summary.label: Rated {average} out of 5, {count, plural, one {1 review} other {{count} reviews}}. Go to the reviews

stars.label: {count, plural, one {1 star out of 5} other {{count} stars out of 5}}

prompt.title: How was your stay?
prompt.body: Tell the next guests about <bdi>{title}</bdi>. You can write a review until {date}.
prompt.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {1 day left} other {{count} days left}}

form.metaDescription: A review of a stay you booked through Bayit.
form.title: Review your stay
form.closes: You can write this review until {date}.
form.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
form.textLabel: What should the next guests know?
form.textHint: At least {count} characters. No phone numbers, emails or links.
form.placeholder: For example: how clean it was, the welcome, the neighbourhood, and what you wish you had known before
form.textTooShort: Your review is too short. Write at least {count} characters.
form.textTooFewLetters: Your review is too short. Write at least {count} letters or digits, not just symbols.
form.textTooLong: Your review is too long. Up to {count} characters.
form.finalBody: Once posted, it can't be edited or deleted. It shows with your first name and the month, for example "Dana · October 2026".
form.confirm: I understand the review can't be edited or deleted
form.confirmRequired: Tick the box to confirm that the review is final.
form.doneTitle: Thank you! Your review is posted
form.doneBody: It now shows on the listing and helps the next guests choose. The host can reply once.
form.posted: You have already reviewed this stay. A review is final, so it can't be changed.
form.postedHidden: Your review of this stay was hidden by the Bayit team and doesn't show on the site.
form.privacy: Only your first name and the month show next to your review. Your full name, the booking and the dates never do.

too_early.title: It's too early to write a review
too_early.body: You can write a review from the day after check-out until {date}.

too_late.title: The time to write a review has passed
too_late.body: Reviews can be written up to 14 days after check-out. For this stay that ended on {date}.

not_stayed.title: This booking can't be reviewed
not_stayed.body: Reviews are only for stays that happened, not for bookings that were cancelled or where you didn't arrive.

not_reviewable_type.title: Monthly rentals and sales have no reviews
not_reviewable_type.body: For now, reviews are only for short stays and hotels.

listing_gone.title: The listing is no longer on the site
listing_gone.body: A deleted listing can't be reviewed.

already_reviewed.title: You have already written a review

errors.not_reviewable_type: For now, reviews are only for short stays and hotels.
errors.listing_gone: The listing is no longer on the site.
errors.not_stayed: Reviews are only for stays that happened.
errors.too_early: It's too early: you can write a review from the day after check-out.
errors.too_late: The time to review this stay has passed.
errors.already_reviewed: You have already reviewed this booking.
errors.contact_in_text: Please leave out phone numbers, emails and links, then try again.
errors.already_replied: You have already replied to this review. A reply is final.
errors.review_hidden: This review was hidden, so it can't get a reply.
errors.already_reported: You have already reported this review. We are looking into it.
errors.details_required: Tell us in a few words what is wrong.
errors.not_hidden: The review is already on the site.
errors.payment_in_text: Please leave out payment details: payment links, bank accounts (IBAN), card numbers or crypto. Guests pay the host on arrival, never in advance.

account.title: Reviews
account.description: Reviews you wrote, and guests' reviews of your places.
account.emptyText: After a stay you booked through Bayit, you can review it. Guests' reviews of your places will show here too.
account.hostLead: You can reply once to each review, and report a review that breaks the rules. Reviews can't be edited or deleted.
account.hiddenHost: The Bayit team hid this review ({reason}). It doesn't show on the site or count in the rating.
account.hiddenGuest: The Bayit team hid your review ({reason}). It doesn't show on the site.
account.emailHint: One email after each stay, with a link to write a review.
account.emailOnSaved: We'll ask you for a review after your next stay.
account.emailOffSaved: We won't email you review requests any more.

reply.label: Your public reply
reply.placeholder: For example: thank you for staying with us, it was a pleasure
reply.finalNote: A reply is final: it can't be edited or deleted, and it shows under the review to everyone who sees the listing. No phone numbers, emails or links.
reply.confirm: I understand the reply can't be edited or deleted
reply.confirmRequired: Tick the box to confirm that the reply is final.
reply.tooShort: The reply is too short. Write at least {count} characters.
reply.tooFewLetters: The reply is too short. Write at least {count} letters or digits, not just symbols.
reply.tooLong: The reply is too long. Up to {count} characters.

report.reported: You reported this review on {date}. We are looking into it.
report.title: Report a review
report.intro: The Bayit team will look at the review. If it breaks the rules, we will hide it. Reviews are never edited.

reasons.OTHER: Something else (for example: the guest didn't stay here, it contains personal details)

report.detailsRequired: Tell us in a few words what is wrong (at least {count} characters).
report.note: A report counts against no one and never shows on the site. We will update you by email.
report.done: Thank you. We will look at the review and update you by email.
report.replyReported: You reported the host's reply on {date}. We are looking into it.
report.replyIntro: The Bayit team will look at the reply. If it breaks the rules, we will hide the review together with it. Replies are never edited.
report.replyDone: Thank you. We will look at the reply and update you by email.

replyReasons.OTHER: Something else (for example: it contains personal details about me)

admin.title: The review
admin.gone: The review no longer exists (its booking was deleted).
admin.showTitle: Put the review back on the site
admin.never: A review can never be edited. You can only hide one that breaks the rules, with a reason, and show it again. Every action is logged.
admin.own: This is your own review or a review of your place: someone else on the team decides.
admin.timeline: What was done with the review

reasons.not_genuine: Not a genuine review (the guest didn't stay)

admin.showNoteLabel: Why does the review go back? (required)
admin.notePlaceholder: What you saw and why you decided this
admin.noteHint: The note stays in the audit log and is never sent to the guest or the host. They get an email with the reason's name only.
admin.shownDone: The review is back on the site

part.review: The review was reported (by the host)
part.reply: The host's reply was reported (by the guest)

admin.replyTarget: A host's reply to a review
admin.hideWithReply: Hiding hides the review together with the host's reply (the reply can't be hidden on its own).
admin.noReports: No one has reported this review.
admin.recentHint: Every new review, including ones nobody reported. Open a review to hide it if it breaks the rules.
admin.recentEmpty: There are no reviews on the site yet.

all.metaDescription: Every review by guests who booked through Bayit and stayed here.

unsubscribe.metaDescription: Stop or restart the email that asks for a review after a stay.

confirm.title: Stop review requests?
confirm.body: We won't email you after a stay to ask for a review. You can still write one from the booking page.

alreadyOff.title: Review requests are already off
alreadyOff.body: You can turn them back on here or on the Reviews page of your account.

off.title: Review requests stopped
off.body: We won't send you these emails any more. You can turn them back on at any time, here or on the Reviews page of your account.

on.title: Review requests are back on
on.body: After your next stay we'll email you a link to write a review.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: It may have been cut short, or the account was deleted. You can choose which emails you get on the Reviews page of your account.

limited.title: Too many tries
limited.body: Try again in an hour, or change the setting on the Reviews page of your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't save the change. Try again in a moment.
